DOWN TWO, AND THIS RESTORES REASONING A REBASE CONFLICT DISCARDED. The project_enterprise dissolve moved `_fetch_planning_overlap` and `_fetch_last_date_end_from_dependent_task_for_all_tasks` into community project, where naming is a contract at zero, so they were renamed `_get_planning_overlap_rows` and `_get_last_predecessor_date_end_per_task` rather than carried. Two abolished verbs leave this scope with them; nothing here was renamed in place. Pinned to that one commit: 216 at its parent, 214 at it, 214 at HEAD. During the 2026-09-09 sync both sides of the replay had banked this floor against their own tree -- 216 from upstream widening the scan, 153 from this branch under the old scan -- and the conflict was resolved to upstream 216 as a placeholder because no textual resolution could be right. This is the measurement that was owed.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

Re-stamped after the 2026-09-08 sync rebased odoo and enterprise onto their origins, which rewrote every SHA and orphaned this floor's measured_at. Only the provenance moved: naming_vocabulary.py --roots enterprise --count reads 216 against the settled pair, the banked count unchanged.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

The SCAN grew, not the tree. naming_vocabulary.py measure() implemented §2.4.13's scope as a class-membership test, so three populations the section governs were counted by census() and gated by nothing: module-level functions and plain-class methods in an addon's models/ wizard/ wizards/ files, and functions nested inside either. odoo ca24a4b847bd put all three in the population. 155 -> 216 is 61 newly VISIBLE names -- 35 nested, 17 on plain classes, 9 at module level -- and NOT 61 new offenders; enterprise's tree is unchanged. The same widening found 26 in addons/ and 6 in agromarin, both swept to zero (689b6949126c, agromarin ac4033bba), so those floors held at 0 and only this one moves, enterprise having no sweep behind it yet. Measured on detached worktrees at odoo 1011731b50d8 and enterprise 68239d338a1, never from the shared checkout -- which for an hour reported 216 against HEAD's gate because it was reading an uncommitted measure(). A floor whose scan widened is indistinguishable from one whose tree regressed, and one whose scan NARROWED is indistinguishable from one somebody paid down, so this note says which: the instrument moved.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

DOWN ONE AFTER THE ENTERPRISE REBASE, RE-STAMPED AT 401369e7fe3. 156 before, 155 after 28 upstream commits arrived. CLAUDE.md section 4 predicts this direction and the reason: a floor carried across a rebase reads high, because the branch banked before upstream's improvements reached it. This is a count of specific offences -- methods spelled with section 2.4's abolished verbs -- rather than a whole-tree sum, so the decrease cannot be one improvement paying for a regression somewhere else. Re-measured in a clean detached worktree laid out beside a clean odoo worktree.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMP REFRESHED, NUMBER UNCHANGED. The old stamp named a commit the 2026-09-02 sync replayed away, so --list flagged it ORPHANED-BASE and the sibling architecture.yml exited 2 asking to be re-measured rather than comparing -- neither green nor red. Re-measured in a clean detached worktree of enterprise at f6fa11352db, laid out beside a clean odoo worktree exactly as the lane does, because these gates resolve the community fork as a sibling and reading one alone inflates the count: unresolved_calls_enterprise measured 11 pointed at the sibling on its own and 3 in the pair.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMPED AGAINST THE RIGHT REPOSITORY. The floor already carried a `measured_at`, but it was an ODOO commit for a gate that measures enterprise, so it resolved cleanly in the wrong checkout and said nothing about the tree that was counted -- `--list` rendered it STAMP-PREDATES-ROOT. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree of enterprise -- python odoo/tooling/architecture/naming_vocabulary.py --roots enterprise --count -- and it reads 156, equal to the floor. Re-banked with `--update --root enterprise`, which records the enterprise commit.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

Re-banked at a reachable commit after this branch was rebased onto origin/19.0-marin. --list had flagged it as banked at a commit that is not in HEAD history: the rebase replaced every commit on this side, so each measured_at named an object no longer reachable. Re-measured on the merged tree rather than carried over. 159 -> 156. Upstream's 159 already carried the iap_extract retirement; the three further units are this branch -- helpdesk_sale_timesheet _confirm_linked_sale_orders, sale_planning _get_or_create_uom_hours, l10n_ec_edi _check_withhold_data_on_post.
